newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Set of C19th Danish pocketwatches go for $352,000.
newsitem.headline: Set of C19th Danish pocketwatches go for $352,000.

text.p: A set of 16 gold pocketwatches by a 19th century Danish watchmaker were sold to an unidentified European buyer for $351,984, more than four times its estimated value, auctioneer Christie's said.

The watches by Jules Juergensen (1808-1877), a third generation watchmaker renowned for his precision work, had been estimated to fetch $80,000 at Christie's watch auction held at a luxury hotel on the edge of Lake Geneva late on Monday.

Auctioneer Sotheby's holds its sale of wristwatches, watches and clocks in the Swiss city on Tuesday. Nearly 180 lots will include a gold and enamel minute repeating perpetual calendar clockwatch, made by Swiss watchmaker Patek Philippe in 1993.
It is expected to go for between $360,000 and $440,000.
